annotations.title: How to apply for someone honestly (the Project Dictionary Method)

description: VeritaHire's method for helping one real person apply: choosing only strong fits, writing the resume and cover letter in the employer's words from the person's true record, filling forms from their saved answers, the steps that stay with the person (passwords, signatures, consents), and common form traps. Open to any assistant.

access_token.description: Not needed when the person signed in through your Connect / sign-in button (OAuth). Otherwise the access_token from finish_connecting.
